description: Closelooknet’s two leading macro monitors in one read: Structural Inflation (26 FRED series, 7 buckets — score, regime, direction, structural-vs-transitory, supply shock) and Growth & Recession (~19 FRED series, 5 buckets — score, regime, direction, recession risk), each with bucket-level z-scores. Mirrors closelook.net/lab/macro/inflation/ and /lab/macro/growth/. Daily on FRED release days.
name: get_macro_regime
title: Macro regime — inflation + growth
